scenes.title: Sela Thorn at pier four
scenes.summary: The party meets Sela Thorn (also called Sella), a tide-reader who will row them for two silver, never at night. She says Saltmere Mine flooded forty years ago the night the bell first rang, with warm water.

scenes.title: The flooded Saltmere Mine
scenes.summary: Warm, candle-wax-smelling air; the tunnel is flooded with warm water and hymn-book pages. A page is annotated 'M. Brand', which Teo recognises as his sister Mira's handwriting. Oren takes 2 damage from bad air (down to 11). Dana and Priya guess the harbor-master Maren is in the cult.

scenes.title: Midnight at the drowned chapel
scenes.summary: Fishermen warn of the Kelp Mother and leave. At midnight the bell rings twelve times under water, the humming is much louder, and pale congregation-like shapes appear on the chapel floor before vanishing. The party flees.

scenes.title: The Tarred Gull
scenes.summary: The party plans to dive to the chapel at low tide tomorrow with Sela rowing at first light. Innkeeper Bram gives them stew and says Maren lost a brother to the bay. Long rest, full HP.
